heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear late, with clouds moving in from the south overnight. Lows from the upper 30s to low 40s. Light and variable wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Mostly cloudy, chance of rain showers mainly south of Route 2 late in the day. Highs from the upper 50s, to near 60. Wind turning south at 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Rain showers spreading north overnight. Lows in the low to mid 40s. Wind becoming light and variable.
